verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Canva exposing an official MCP *server* so external AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) can call Canva's own design tools (canva-docs-5, canva-docs-28, canva-probe-4) — the opposite direction of the story, which asks whether Canva itself can act as an MCP client plugging into external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence shows Canva consuming or configuring external MCP servers.
